scope: Motion statement boundaries within existing parsed control flow

contracts.repeat: A bare UNTIL after MOVE belongs to the nearest active parsed block only when that block is a REPEAT body
contracts.with: A following WITH MOVE is a separate source statement; its checked settings belong only to that following request
contracts.local_clauses: Comma-led WHEN/UNTIL clauses and ENDMOVE retain existing parsing and runtime behavior
contracts.lifetime: Parser block boundaries unwind on success or error; compiled loops retain ordinary routines, linked ownership and pause continuations
contracts.diagnostics: Orphan WHEN/UNTIL identifies required scope; premature terminators or EOF inside handler actions name ENDMOVE or ENDCONDITION with physical locations
contracts.evidence: Authored translation, offline execution, linked and CLI fixtures; no native compiler or controller acceptance claim

retained_boundaries: Malformed inner blocks cannot borrow an enclosing REPEAT terminator
A local motion clause still requires a comma and ENDMOVE; a WITH prefix requires its own MOVE
MOVE/WITH remain unavailable inside handler actions
Explicit motion services and ownership remain required; no inferred trajectories, feedback or native scheduling
